notes.title: "... And Another one!" Update
notes.content:
Surprise, Everyone! We have an update 🎉 

Of course we were gonna continue fixing patches either way, but I realized, once a game is done, if you want to make extra content, that's just gravy, right? Who doesn't love gravy?

We're adding a bonus level that requires you to find all the previous secrets. The new level has a new item (The Squirt Stone 💦 🪨), a new enemy (The Fanatic 🐰 🔥), new rabbit world lore (👩🏼🐇🪱), and is just bonkers full of mechanics. It definitely takes some effort to access, and is a bit of an ordeal to beat, so if you love these puzzle battles like we do, we think you're gonna have a real fun time.

Have fun!

notes.title: Patch for version 1.2
notes.content:
A bunch of little improvements. I personally like the new controller button icons a lot, and hope you all try it out with a nice gamepad in hand


Prophecy Prism and Coal new have correct confirmation box descriptions.
Coal and Gods' Wine are no longer limited by having full shield
Several crashing bugs fixed
New icons for controller buttons
Implemented ttf font instead of bitmap font.

The biggest change is the new ttf font. Sure, it allows kerning, and that's nice (I mean it looks REAL good), but the actual advantage is that we can slowly translate the game into languages with other character sets (we have the intro in Japanese in a secret branch!). Dunno if that'll ever happen, but at least now we can!

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content:
Thank you everyone who played the game so far! And thank you to those of you who left reviews. It's absolutely the best feedback to fix and improve the game, even though it's ostensibly done. We love to talk to you guys about the game, so please tell more people about it, or give us more feedback.

Fixes and Changes


 Saving system is fixed (if you crash, the game saves correctly while moving around on world map, and after completing levels.
 Lore scenes are correctly added to Extras menu after completing quests in World 3
 Level previews now show how many battles the level consists of.
 Final Boss will show golden smoke after attacking, while in Divine state (the golden smoke still breaks if the final boss is damaged by a Null Pyre or Volatile explosion).

Other Comments

A very nice review noticed that pressing "back" in the world map behaved in a confusing manner. We've have planned out how to fix this, though it isn't in this patch.

Same review noticed that pressing "End turn" requires confirming with the same "End turn" button. That's actually on purpose, to make sure players don't end their turn accidentally.

There used to be a tutorial level explaining how Null Pyres work. Test players just got bored, and it seems a lot of players found joy in gaining the understanding on their own.

That's it for now. Thank again everyone!

notes.title: PATCH 5 - The Danes are all here!
notes.content:
Danish t{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44210842/97f3b835f9debbdd5111110b5e94eed75629139f.pngranslation for early access is done.

Finally got there. Enemy moves and status effects aren't translated yet, but all the dialogue for the Early Access portion of the game are finally translated into Danish, and what's more, it's enabled us to easily add translations for other languages. Note: if you a language besides English or Danish, and would like to help us provide a translation, we'd really appreciate it.

Counter for Cosmewts

These little rascals didn't feel quite special enough, so now, instead of just being idle, they have counter stance. Careful! They'll counter anything.

World 3 Quest

This one didn't feel quite right yet, but we changed it a little bit, and now I believe it's settled. Makes you think for a few seconds.

Final chapter is close to done. Has a bunch of new mechanics

We've worked a bunch on the final chapter. It's almost starting to feel like DLC, with all it's little new mechanics here and there.

What else?

We were featured on some very nice streams. Hiokleo featured us TWICE! And she got real good at the game too. And then HailHeidi played the game as well (https://www.twitch.tv/hailheidi/video/2196020345).

Finally, we were interviewed on Danish video game podcast Lupinvej (https://lupinvej.buzzsprout.com/1796379/15459725-the-girl-who-kicked-a-rabbit-dev-interview-med-sketchwhale)

That was a real fun chat. If you speak the language, give it a listen.

This might be the last update for Early Access before the full release. The game has really game come together, and with the final world shaping up to be good time, the end is in sight.

notes.title: Quick Little Patch (QLP!)
notes.content:
Just a quick little patch.

- Objectives and other such information once again displays the "target information". "Use douse", "Kill 5 Mother" etc. A bug cause it to all just read "Use nil", "Kill 5 nil" and such.
- The word Searing Ice is removed. The item "Agony Glass" was the new name for Searing Ice, but we forgot to change it everywhere.

notes.title: Patch 4 - 'Cordial Ownership!"
notes.content:
This isn't a big content update, but the changes included are just so dang delightful, that there isn't really a reason to wait.


 Animated backgrounds in story scenes
It looks great, though it's a subtle difference. I promise, for the upcoming 4th stage, it'll be important.

 Game autosaves when ending combat and story scenes
We've never been too explicit about how saving works in the game, but this one is super important, especially after we saw the streamer Alliiebug crash on stream and having to start all over.

 When folding, cursor stays on Arcana that is folded.
A few players might have been confused why their cursor got catapulted to the other end of the inventory. No more!

 Language can be changed with F3 at all times
Not sure how many of you constantly switch between Danish and English while playing, but now it's easier than ever.

 Scrolling inventory
Was technically part of the previous patch, but we'll count it here as well. That's right. Got too many items? Not a problem, the inventory now scrolls.

 Mechanics for post-early access have been implemented (so, you know... get excited)

 Status moves are translated now
Ever wondered what 'staggered' is called in Danish?

 Intros play on all stages when selecting from stage menu
Get the full experience whenever you're starting from.

 Status effects on enemies are now displayed below their action/name
Apparently we can never be too explicit.


The changes are also reflected in the demo this time :)

In other news, we had two delightful streamers trying the game.
Alliiebug had a real fun time here https://www.twitch.tv/videos/2183993320 and even streamed herself painting our first piece of fan art!
MekaXKitty was pretty frustrated with the drop rate of Agony Glass https://www.twitch.tv/videos/2183993320 but it was still great to see her stream.

Also! The Infinite Review featured our trailer on their 'This is E3' video! That's blasting! "Like Advance Wars-" YOU GET IT! https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6yRgsroov88

Thank you to both of you!

And as a side event, Gettauay was so kind as to feature our Nordic Game Jam 2024 game, 'Home Dungeon' on her stream of those jam projects: https://www.twitch.tv/videos/2184053693

notes.title: Little patch!
notes.content:
Hi, everyone!

Recent work has mostly been on the content for after early access, but we just implemented a feature long-sought-after: If your inventory grows beyond 16 items, it will now scroll if your cursor moves far enough to the side. Oh and we also updated demo to take advantage of all the many updates from the last few months. The demo hasn't had a lot of testing recently, so please provide some feedback if you enjoy it, but are experiencing some bugs.

notes.title: Update 3 - Part 1 "The Danish Are Almost here!"
notes.content:
Update 3 was supposed to be new visual elements, but as that is taking a bit more time than planned, we chose to focus on something we manage until then.

This update brings the second world, known as "9:30 p.m." to the Danish translation. It also has translations for every  lore piece, including those found in the third world ("3 a.m.") which generally not translated yet otherwise (besides the openings before its optional fights (they are optional people!)

If you happen to know Danish, definitely give it a chance. Video games are rarely translated into Danish, so this provides a unique experience.

notes.title: Quick patch -> reset button!
notes.content:
Just a quick patch.

If your game crashes when you go to the 'Extras' menu, we've added a solution:  A button that deletes corrupted entries.

We've been making changes to enable translations in the game. This has caused some problems, and the hacky solution we are adding, is a reset button in the Options menu. Right now it just deletes the additional lore entries you might have collected, because they were from the previous system.

Sorry for the inconvenience!

notes.title: Patch 2: Accelerated Catastrophe
notes.content:
Hi again everyone!

We're finally releasing patch 2, "Accelerated Catastrophe". It has quite a lot more than we expected, so let's get to it:

CONTENT


 An overhaul to world 2. No longer as open as before, we added a couple of chain levels to it as well
 A bigger variety of goals to accomplish as well
 Overhaul to world 3. All quests are now mandatory, but will all result in optional fights with rewards instead.
 Which means: three now levels for world 3, where you get to try out the "Advance" spell and the "Collapse" spell. Since this is Early Access, a warning, the Advance spell is fickle and might crash the game. We are working on it.
 A general ID system has been implemented behind the scene for all of Lumi's moves and levels. We still need to finish it up, but this will definitely help with future translations.


CHANGES


 Searing Ice is now called Agony Glass.
 Fragile state is now Glass state
 Which statuses affect the damage received is now displayed with the damage: "2 (Glass, Poison)"
 Hid secret level in world 1 behind conditions
 Changed flow of the very first map, to tell people to stop at the first location


BUG FIXES

 Twin Slap attack now shows targettng arrows
 Reward move now shows a green targeting arrow
 Douse no longer consumes a Nox
 Tried to fix crashes from Advance (not quite fixed)


Since last time we've shown the game off at local Maker Faire in Denmark. Lots of kids and adults played it. It was a real confidence boost.

We also participated in Nordic Game Jam 2024, where we made sort of tactical puzzle game, called Home Dungeon. Feel free to try it: https://takunomi.itch.io/home-dungeon

And the very sweet vero_cat played the game on stream for several hours, though the VOD appears to be gone now. Still, check out her channel, she was really good at it: https://www.twitch.tv/vero_cat


There was an interview with us on Danish gaming site arkaden.dk: https://arkaden.dk/arkaden-fortaeller-spiludvikling-som-en-passion/ (Thank you to Kasper Pedersen for a pleasant lunch)

That's it for this patch. Next time we hope focus on adding more visual upgrades and giving the second boss an overhaul as well. See you soon!

notes.title: EARLY ACCESS RELEASE + PATCH 1 ("Stupid Premonitions")
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We released this game into Early Access and then promptly fell asleep from exhaustion. When we woke there was so much stuff to think about.

A bunch of people bought the game and we are so grateful for that. And with players comes bugs, improvements and new content.

First, a look at the updates:

 New UI to indicate blocked Null Pyres. A bunch of players misunderstood this mechanic. Hopefully this makes it clearer.
 The Advance move (few players probably acquired this) now shows its cursor when selecting a target.
 A bunch of spelling errors were corrected.
 The secret level now has a secret reward (Shhhhhhh!)
 A second secret level has been added (With another secret reward (SHHHHHH!)
 "Sol Strike" is now "Overslap" and indicates the Solar is damaged as well
 Windball has been removed and generally been replaced by Baneboon or other moves.
 Baneboon will be more useful now. If it drops a Catalyst, this Catalyst is guaranteed to match the current Douse recipe if necessary.
 The Ogre got more health as it simply perished too quickly.
 Douse deals less damage now.


That were the improvements for patch 1, "Stupid Premonitions".

Besides that, we were fortunate enough for a couple of kind streamers to give the game a try. First we had Zokubun playing the game for a couple of hours: https://www.twitch.tv/videos/2112770394

And then NifHawk played for even longer: https://www.twitch.tv/videos/2116206557

What a wonderful Early Access launch. Thank you everyone!

notes.title: ANNOUNCING EARLY ACCESS RELEASE DATE!
notes.content:
Okay. Here we go.

On March 31st, 2024, we will release the Early Access version of The Girl Who Kicked a Rabbit.

It will include the tutorial world, and worlds 1 through 3.
It will cost 7.00 $/€.

WHAT TO EXPECT

This will give you a big chunk of the full game!

The second world is tough, requiring that you really use all the mechanics in the game, including weird spells you haven't seen yet, a bunny demon that can hardly be called an enemy, and a really skull-breakingly tough boss: The Ogre.

In the third world you're probably gonna want to relax a little, so priorities change a bit. Still... something awaits at the end. Something... You'll see.


RELEASE PLAN

During Early Access, we plan to gradually include updates such as


 Graphical improvements (more animations, new backgrounds, more effects for boss spells)
 Gradual Danish translation
 Continuous bug fixes
 Balancing improvements


Particularly the latter two simply just require that people try the game and tell us what issues they are having. Being an indie project made in our spare time, it feels wrong to release the full game at full price without it having been played more thoroughly by others outside the developers and their friends and family. At the same time, it also feels like we are asking for free playtesters (well, actually you'll be paying us). I suppose that's technically what Early Access is, but it feels weird.

As for the Danish translation, we realise the audience is tiny, but since we speak it, we often find new ways to phrase an idea or say a joke that is more fun, and since we've already translated a good deal, we'll finish it. It takes time though, as the game has actually become somewhat bigger in terms of hidden lore content.

CREATORS & JOURNALISTS

If you want to try the game early, please contact us either here, through Twitter (https://twitter.com/GirlKickRabbit) or by email at ohayo.jacob@gmail.com

We already have a bunch of people we are grately towards, that will be receiving a download key, but if you want to cover the game on your channel, blog, or wherever, we'd love to help out.

FINAL RELEASE

Once we've fixed the stuff you told us was broken and unbalanced for a month or two, we'll release the full game including the final fourth world, for the full price of 10.00 $/€

We'll conclude the story of Lumi's night of patrolling when we release the fourth and final world in the full release. There's plenty of secret lore in the Early Access version, but all the pieces won't be available till you play world 4.

Thank you to everyone who has given the early versions or the demo a try over the years. Participating in Steam Next Fest and the various conventions we attended, were real highlights of the experience. Seeing kids (and a couple of grown-ups) play through it (multiple times!) really gave us the confidence to say: Somebody is going to like this. This is worth finishing. Well... We're almost there.

takunomi

notes.title: Post-Next Fest Demo Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone, Sketchwhale here, the designer.

This Next Fest was just so great. Honestly I couldn't stop myself being glued to the internet, checking for comments, feedback, download stats and new wishlist additions.

The initial demo had some unfortunate bugs, but we got them (thanks to you!). And both during and after the event, great feedback rolled in. Comments about gameplay mechanics that were hard to understand, or issues with random elements. We've quickly worked to address some of the issues, and so we're now releasing a POST-NEXT FEST PATCH. Right, right, patch notes:


 The Player Shield System has a visual overhaul, to show that shields are unique from extra health
 The rare Solar enemy has a Twin Slap ability.
 Solar strong attack damage goes from 6 to 5.
 Almost all Catalysts now have a secondary ability:

 Aurum heals (like before)
 Wood now gives 2 shield points
 Sugar poisons you (yes, there is poison now) but also gives a random bonus item.
 Bamboo removes poison
 Coal is like a small grenade damaging all
 Chutney absorbs 1 Searing Ice

 Improved floating text. This will notify you of many little changes and better tell you of damage given and received. As an example, normal damage is yellow, but critical hits are red.
 Rewrote the dialogue for the level with all the Searing Ice, to better explain the mechanic.


Hopefully some of these changes will playing the demo more fun. Parts of the game don't yet take different languages into account yet, so certain elements will always be in English, until we fix that.

I and the rest of the team look forward to hearing more feedback from you, and are still striving to announce an Early Access release date soon!

Kind regards, Sketchwhale and the rest of the takunomi team

notes.title: Soft-lock Fixed, Crashing Bugs Fixed, Some Balancing Thoughts
notes.content:
Thank you for a wonderful Next Fest everyone. It's not over yet, but still worth saying. We've fixed some more issues as noted below, so an update was in order.


 Tiny update based on player feedback. There was a softlock in a level because volatile enemies that were killed weren't counted towards to goal.

 Also discovered and fixed a bunch of crashing bugs.

 Someone was kind enough to point out that the drop rate of necessary items in the final level of the demo could be rather unforgiving and seemed almost random. We test played it a couple of times and found the level to be as intended, but if we keep hearing issues with this, we'll revisit it.

notes.title: Demo Build Update for Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
🐰 Hi everyone! 🎊

We're taking part in the February 2024 edition of Steam Next Fest, and so we worked really hard to have:


🐉 The demo updated and ready, including new, secret, optional lore content

🍾 The Danish translation

🌌 Improved visuals (animations in backgrounds, new backgrounds) and mechanical additions

You might also have noticed the game has a nice trailer now.

What's after the Steam Next Fest? Release, actually. Or rather, Early Access:


👧 Sometime in late February, early March, we're hoping to release the game in an Early Access version.

It's still a question of whether to release a limited version that represents the final game, or the entire game, but with the final chapter still needing a nice polish.

Either way, the Early Access version will be cheaper, and then a slight price bump once the game is done.
